Vik explicitly selected the next pair with "Sweet let's do it" after b2f2664 workflow-repair activation at c13f84d. Freeze 0a4eb40 / SHA116c93f6fa49eef858588a78a134fa3e922003a22b8237db6aaa655da646b3b2 was published and remotely read back before two fresh native Terra/high/fork-none attempts. Both used the exact original t16/t21 prompts and finished under the 300-second cap without nudges, retries or replacements. One unpublished draft was preserved and superseded for protocol trailing whitespace before any publication or trial. No product code changed.

Median input is 402423 tokens versus original baseline 249298: 1.614225 times baseline, still failing the original 1.25 limit. It is 16.0% below the previous 479060 pair, 40.7% below the original 678996.5 regression, but 12.7% above the first repaired pair's 357203. Individual inputs are 394978 and 409868. Median cached input is 361472 and uncached 40951. Median visible bytes115227 is0.937785 times baseline and passes. Median elapsed98274.5ms is1.335197 times baseline and fails. Outer rounds are8/10, median9 versus baseline5.5 and previous11. These are two samples per condition with retained caches and current host/instructions, not billed dollars, population estimates or isolated graph-causal savings.

Both agents invoke Loci:9 retrieves/3 reads,53 native relationship records. Both receive the required CaptureCommandResultOptions -> WorkContextBinding graph content. One has unique full_exact native-call attribution; the other's complete displayed packet matches two identical native calls, preserving ambiguous_exact. Every read exactly reuses an earlier issued30-character reference and succeeds;131 source records validate. Frozen delivery-v4 retains8full_exact,2ambiguous_exact,2unproven calls. The two unproven packets are complete nested structuredContent values under view/validator; the original observer marks them full, and a separate strict JSON comparison validates every field. Neither frozen observer is rewritten. Delivered content does not establish internal model reliance.

Independent fresh Sol/high semantic review is adopted. Both core binding/view distinctions are correct; both have2/3 complete original facts because neither explicitly names CaptureCommandResultOptions despite receiving that declaration. The second also incorrectly calls the publicly re-exported WorkContextBinding private. Source access passes2/2. Runtime claims are supported for an unadapted bare view, without claiming a particular runtime caller or excluding caller-side adaptation. Earlier frozen reviewers credited the options-name clause more generously, so fact counts are not a calibrated historical quality trend.

All54 current frozen inputs and both638-file source snapshots pass postflight; historical45/28/46 frozen artifact inputs are unchanged. Original native intervals stay local with bounded observations/provenance published. Full ambient prompt attribution remains limited. The selected experiment is finished with a negative value verdict; W1.8.4.4 and the wider Objective remain open.

Retained traces identify remaining round trips: one agent projected empty content, discarded structuredContent and repeated the same function request. Schema lookups returned related context before exact file/shell fallback. Recommended next W1.8.4.4 is to decompose deterministic result-presentation and focused schema/declaration lookup follow-through against these traces, then verify locally before another selected campaign. This recommendation does not select a new repair or trial or establish a new implementation diagnosis.

## Current Orientation

The ordinary graph-adoption Objective remains in Implementation. The selected
v3 two-binding comparison is complete: both fresh agents use Loci and receive
the required binding graph content, and all three short-reference reads succeed.
Median input falls 16.0% from the previous pair to **402,423 tokens**, but remains
**1.6142 times the original baseline** and fails the unchanged 1.25 limit.
Elapsed time also fails at 1.3352 times baseline; visible bytes pass at 0.9378.

The two first Terra/high, fork-none attempts followed the exact original prompts
under the published `0a4eb40` freeze, after `b2f2664` activated in the actual
host at `c13f84d`. Both finished under 300 seconds without nudges, replacement
or retries. All 54 frozen inputs and both 638-file source snapshots pass.
Historical 45/28/46 frozen artifact inputs remain unchanged.

Both core binding/view distinctions are correct. Independent Sol/high review
finds two of three complete original facts in each answer: neither names
`CaptureCommandResultOptions` despite receiving the declaration. The second
also incorrectly labels the publicly re-exported binding type private. Source
access passes for both. Earlier reviewers credited the options-name clause
more generously; individual fact counts are not a calibrated historical trend.

Nine retrieves and three reads return 53 relationship records. Required proof
content reaches both agents; one has unique `full_exact` call attribution and
the other's complete displayed packet matches two identical calls. Their frozen
`ambiguous_exact` status remains. Two nested structured values separately pass
strict JSON equality despite a delivery-v4 coverage gap; original observers and
scores stay unchanged. This establishes delivered content, not internal reliance.

Median outer rounds are 9 versus baseline 5.5 and previous 11. Cached input is
361,472 and uncached input 40,951. The input trend is baseline 249,298, original
regression 678,996.5, first repair 357,203, previous pair 479,060, current pair
402,423. These are two samples per condition with retained caches and current
host guidance, not billed dollars, population estimates or isolated graph effects.

**Recommended next: W1.8.4.4 — decompose deterministic result presentation and
focused schema/declaration lookup follow-through from the retained traces.**
One agent discarded `structuredContent` by projecting empty `content`, then
repeated the same request. Schema searches caused further related-context
retrievals before exact file/shell reads. Establish the warranted mechanism and
verify locally before another selected benchmark. This result selects no new
repair or provider campaign; the selected measurement is finished.

Normal retrieval's supported input-path priority and persistent 30-character
references remain active. Fixed graph/source budgets, exact validation, cache
expiry, static omissions and unsupported signature-role qualifications remain.
The previous 66 local tests and nine actual-host acceptance calls are retained
implementation evidence. Broader ordinary-value and full-workload acceptance
remain open.
